::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[XeLaTeX and EPS figure with consistent fonts](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/5319/xelatex-and-eps-figure-with-consistent-fonts), asked by [pluton](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/371/pluton) on TeX Stack Exchange (2010-11-13; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> I'm using Miktex 2.9 and XeLaTeX plus some EPS figures. For consistent fonts throughout the document, I used to play with [psfrag][q-1] or directly use [pstricks][q-2]. I'm facing the situation where none of the above works. Instead, I'm now using the `\put` command to place labels on EPS figures. I'd like to know others possibles approaches : Inkscape? [tikZ][q-3]?
>
>   [q-1]: http://ctan.org/pkg/psfrag
>   [q-2]: http://ctan.org/pkg/pstricks
>   [q-3]: http://ctan.org/pkg/pgf
:::

There's the `overpic` package which provides an environment of included graphics `picture` overlay.  You can definitely use pgf/tikz, but if you're not already it might be overkill.
